verdict.rationale: Intel publishes a per-SKU specifications page for the 285K. It lists max clock (up to 5.70 GHz), cache, ECC memory support and supported AI frameworks, and a hands-on review confirms an official rated DDR5-6400 memory speed. However, the pack shows no vendor-published power figures, no AI TOPS number and no test conditions, and much of the remaining vendor material is marketing adjectives. missing for 10: published power/TDP figures, AI TOPS rating, test conditions behind the numbers, full memory speed/capacity specs in first-party docs, and independent corroboration that the spec sheet is complete.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can comparison-shop from a real spec sheet — the vendor publishes clocks, power, memory support, and AI TOPS with test conditions, instead of marketing adjectives
